Name: CP Lunaheus Pink Flower Calendar
Author: lunaheus
Description:
REQUIREMENTS:SMAPI Content Patcher 2.8.1+

INSTALLATION:1. Unzip the file.2. Drop the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

3. Launch the game.

UNINSTALLATION:Simply delete the [CP] LunaheusPinkFlowerCalendar folder from your Mods folder.

COMPATIBILITY:Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+Compatible with other UI or recolor mods, as long as they don’t edit the calendar texture directly.

Manifest.Name: Lunaheus's Pink Flower Calendar
Manifest.Description: A dreamy pink-themed wall calendar furniture with Lunaheus's soft and magical aesthetic
Manifest.Author: Lunaheus
